commit.message:
Fix verdict/receipt 404: read on-chain attestation when local cache is missing

The /verdict/[id] page 404'd for attestations whose receipt file was
wiped from the gitignored .receipts cache (host restart / redeploy).
The on-chain RankingAttestation had 35 attestations but only ~17 cache
files survived, so any id >=17 linked from /trail hit notFound().

- add lib/attestation/record.ts: readAttestationRecordById reads the
  durable on-chain record (never depends on ephemeral disk cache)
- rewrite app/verdict/[id]/page.tsx to always load the on-chain record
  first; renders full table when the local ranking cache is present,
  otherwise an honest 'not cached' notice with the verifiable on-chain
  proof. Never 404s a real attestation; never fabricates agent rows.
- lib/utils/receipt-store.ts: make StoredReceipt.view nullable, add
  existsReceipt()
- script/trail-worker.ts: add repair mode that backfills missing receipt
  caches from the on-chain ledger (run mode repairs first)

Verified: typecheck, 64 tests, build, and live HTTP smoke test
(/verdict/34 -> 200 from on-chain, /verdict/9999 -> 404).

commit.message:
Install Vercel Web Analytics

Implemented Vercel Web Analytics for the LedgerGuard project.

Summary:
Successfully installed and configured @vercel/analytics package following the latest official Vercel documentation.

Changes Made:

1. **Installed Package:**
   - Added @vercel/analytics (v2.0.1) to dependencies
   - Used npm with --legacy-peer-deps flag to resolve peer dependency conflicts

2. **Modified Files:**
   - app/layout.tsx: Added Analytics component import and integration
     * Imported Analytics from '@vercel/analytics/next'
     * Added <Analytics /> component to the body section of the root layout

3. **Updated Lock Files:**
   - package-lock.json: Updated with new dependency tree

Implementation Details:
- Framework: Next.js 16.1.0 (App Router)
- Package Manager: npm
- Following official Vercel documentation, the Analytics component was added to the root layout file (app/layout.tsx) as recommended for Next.js App Router projects
- The component was placed at the end of the body section to ensure optimal page load performance

Verification:
✅ Build completed successfully (npm run build)
✅ TypeScript linter passed with no errors (npm run lint)
✅ All 64 tests passed (npm test)
✅ No runtime errors introduced

Next Steps:
Once deployed to Vercel, Web Analytics will automatically begin tracking page views and Web Vitals metrics. No additional configuration or environment variables are required for basic functionality. Analytics data will be available in the Vercel dashboard under the Analytics tab.
